# Nutrition

### WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

At Au Bon Pain, we believe eating well is very important. What you eat should be nutritious AND delicious...which is why we are working to provide the right balance for you. Whether you want healthful dishes, refreshing drinks, nutrition packed snacks, complete meals, or from time to time, an indulgent treat, you can be sure your choice is flavorful and of the highest quality. To ensure smart, healthful, nutritious and innovative menu offerings and ingredients, we have assembled an expert culinary team experienced in quality and nutrition.

Making smart choices doesn't have to be hard. You'll find full nutrition profiles for every menu item and suggestions for high fiber, gluten-free and reduced sodium selections on our nutrition kiosks in cafes.

 

The nutritional information is based on Au Bon Pain's standard recipes and individual items may differ depending on a number of variables including variations in size and portioning that are inevitable when items are made by hand. Other factors that may cause actual nutritional values to differ include variations in serving sizes, preparation techniques, ingredient substitutions and changes in supply sources. Because of this we can't guarantee the nutrition content is precisely accurate. We base the values we publish on information provided to us by our suppliers and our own analysis using industry standard software, published resources and/or testing.

 

The nutrition information reflects the nutrition content of company operated cafes in the U.S. In some instances franchised cafes offer items that may vary either in nutritional content or allergen presence. Please speak to your local Au Bon Pain General Manger if you have any questions about the items served in the café you are visiting. Some items may not be available in all Au Bon Pain cafés.

For nutritional information, please see the detailed nutrition information on each product page, or reference our nutrition guide for our full list of products.

How does the Original Pretzel have only 5 grams of fat?

It's true. Our Original Pretzel only contains 5 grams of fat, and, yes, it is lightly dipped in butter. Since Auntie Anne's Pretzels are made fresh in our stores, you can request your pretzel without butter for a lower calorie option or order your pretzel without salt. You may not know that our Original, Cinnamon Sugar, and Jalapeño Pretzels, when served without butter, average just 1 gram of fat. Visit our nutrition section to find out more.

How can I reheat my pretzels at home?

Here are our suggestions for reheating your pretzel:

  * Conventional Oven/Toaster Oven: Preheat oven to 400°. If pretzel is frozen, allow it to thaw. Wrap pretzel in foil and bake approximately 3 minutes.
  * Microwave Oven: If pretzel is frozen, allow it to thaw. Microwave pretzel for approximately 10-15 seconds on medium setting. Repeat as necessary.

### Reviews & Ratings

Content and/or functionality on this page requires you to accept cookies.

[Button: Accept All Cookies]

## FAQs

  * ## [Button: What is Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough ice cream? ]

Ben & Jerry's Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough ice cream combines creamy vanilla ice cream with gobs of chocolate chip cookie dough for a flavor that tastes like eating cookie dough straight from the bowl.

  * ## [Button: Does Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough ice cream contain allergens?]

Yes. It contains milk, eggs, wheat and soy, so it's not suitable for anyone with allergies to those ingredients. Always review the package label for the latest ingredient information before consuming. 

  * ## [Button: When was Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough ice cream invented?]

Ben & Jerry's created the first chocolate chip cookie dough ice cream in 1984 at its original Scoop Shop in Burlington, Vermont, after an anonymous customer suggested mixing gobs of cookie dough into vanilla ice cream. It proved so popular that Ben & Jerry's started selling it in pints in 1991.

  * ## [Button: Is the cookie dough in Ben & Jerry’s Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough safe to eat? ]

Yes. The cookie dough is specifically produced for inclusion in ice cream and is intended to be eaten as part of the finished product. Want to go straight to the chunks? Ben & Jerry’s also has a line of snackable Cookie Dough Chunks. 

  * ## [Button: What formats is Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough available in, and is there a dairy-free option?]

Ben & Jerry’s Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough is available in several formats, including dairy pints, non-dairy pints, mini cups, ice cream bars, and by the scoop at Scoop Shops. The non-dairy version is made with an oat milk base instead of dairy, making it a suitable option for people avoiding milk or following a vegan diet.

# Nutritional Information

## Biaggi’s Nutritional Information

Our culinary teams in all Biaggi’s locations are passionately committed to providing you with an exceptional dining experience and will work to accommodate nutritional or dietary needs whenever possible. Our scratch kitchen provides more opportunities to add or withhold ingredients, change the manner of cooking and substitute side dishes and sauces.

We invite you to discuss your nutritional or dietary needs with your server so that they can inform the culinary team who will, when possible, make the necessary modifications. We’re happy to provide assistance in determining modifications or substitutions to accommodate dietary needs, including dressings or sauces served on the side, reduced-fat dressing or substitute a side salad or steamed vegetables in place of potatoes or fries. Select one of our Italian restaurants in Colorado, Illinois, Iowa, Indiana, Nebraska, Minnesota, Wisconsin, or Ohio to view specific menus, hours, & contact information.

Also our Gluten-Free menu provides selections for a gluten-restricted diet so your dining choices don’t have to be limited. At Biaggi’s, we recognize the challenges of dietary restrictions and we’re happy to provide gluten-intolerant guests with a variety of options that are never lacking in flavor, made with the care & quality that you expect from Biaggi’s!

# Nutrition & Allergy Information

The information provided in our Nutrition & Allergen Guide is based on ingredient information provided by our suppliers. Because our food is prepared in shared kitchens, normal restaurant operations may involve shared preparation and cooking areas, equipment, utensils, and fryers. As a result, cross-contact with allergens may occur, and we cannot guarantee that any menu item is completely free of allergens.

Our restaurants handle ingredients that contain the nine major food allergens: milk, eggs, fish, Crustacean shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans, and sesame. # Coffee Nutrition Facts (Black Coffee)

# Coffee Nutrition Facts (Black Coffee)

When enjoyed black, coffee is one of the lowest-calorie beverages available, with minimal macronutrients and small amounts of naturally occurring minerals.

## Standard Serving

8 fl oz (237 ml) brewed black coffee (arabica)

### Nutrition Breakdown

  * Calories: 2
  * Total Fat: 0g (0% DV)
  * Cholesterol: 0mg (0% DV)
  * Sodium: 0–2mg (0% DV)
  * Total Carbohydrates: 0g (0% DV)
  * Sugars: 0g
  * Protein: 0.3g

### Key Micronutrients

  * Potassium: ~100–120mg (2–3% DV)
  * Magnesium: ~7mg (2% DV)
  * B Vitamins: Trace amounts (notably Riboflavin/B2 and Niacin/B3)

*Percent Daily Values (DV) are based on a 2,000 calorie diet.

## What This Means

Black coffee delivers:

  * Virtually zero calories
  * No fat, sugar, or carbs
  * Small amounts of essential minerals

It’s a strong fit for low-calorie, low-carb, and fasting-friendly routines.

## Important Notes by Coffee Type

Not all coffee formats have identical nutrition profiles:

  * Espresso: More concentrated per ounce, but similar overall composition
  * Decaf Coffee: Nearly identical nutrition, minus most caffeine
  * Instant Coffee: May contain slightly higher sodium and trace carbs
  * Chicory Coffee: Different composition, including small amounts of carbohydrates
  * Flavored or “Mocha” Coffee: Can contain significant calories, sugar, and fat depending on added ingredients (milk, syrups, etc.)

## In a Nutshell (of Coffee Bean)

If you’re drinking black coffee, you’re getting a near-zero calorie beverage with minimal nutritional impact and small amounts of beneficial minerals.

Once you start adding cream, sugar, or flavorings, the nutrition profile changes significantly.

How do I request donations and sponsorships?

Carvel Franchisor SPV LLC is certified kosher by KOF-K Kosher Supervision. KOF-K Kosher Supervision, one of the largest and most accepted kosher agencies in the U.S., which approves all ingredients that Carvel Corporation distributes to our franchisees. Shoppes may carry additional ingredients that are not kosher certified, and/or may not use kosher practices in the shoppe. Please check with your local Carvel® shoppe or our store locator to see if a specific shoppe is kosher certified.

Where can I purchase Carvel® gift cards?

Carvel gift cards can be purchased online or from participating Carvel locations. To find participating locations, please visit our store locator. Or buy online at https://carvel.cashstar.com/store/recipient?locale=en-us

Is it possible to tour a Carvel® store or facility?

Policies and participation may vary between locations. A tour of your local Carvel Shoppe should be arranged through the store owner or manager. Public tours of our production facilities are not available for sanitary and quality reasons.

What is BOGO Wednesday?

BOGO Wednesday is a special offer available on sundaes—buy one, get one free! Visit your local Carvel on Wednesdays to take advantage of this sweet deal.

Carvel Allergen Statement

Some products may contain food allergens and other ingredients that cause food sensitivities. Although efforts are made to avoid cross contact of allergens and other ingredients that may cause food sensitivities, all food and beverage items may contain or come into contact with one or more of these substances.

Animal Products

The only animal products are milk and eggs. The mono and diglycerides are derived from soy, not from an animal source.

Gluten

Most of our ice creams are gluten-free. However, the chocolate crunchies that are found in our ice cream cakes are not gluten-free. Any of our Carvel retail stores will be happy to substitute something else, such as fudge, for crunchies. Please review our nutrition and allergen guide for the most up to date information.

Milk product

Milk found in all our ice cream is pasteurized and is not frozen until the ice cream is made in the shoppe.

Nuts

Our stores are not nut free. Our individual product pages identify products that are nut friendly.

Soy

Soy is found in many of our products in the form of soybean oil, soy lecithin, and mono & diglycerides.

Alcohol in Products

Most of the flavors added to our ice cream mixes contain alcohol. Alcohol is a common carrier for flavors, and in the finished product, there is a low level. The processing of our ice cream causes most of the alcohol to dissipate but we cannot guarantee that our products do not contain alcohol.

Corn Syrup

There is corn syrup in our chocolate and vanilla ice cream but it is not high fructose.

Guar Gum

Guar gum is derived from a bean. It has the same qualities as corn starch, but about 10 times as powerful.

# Nutrition Information

about our ingredients

Amish-raised, antibiotic-free chicken. St. Louis–cut ribs, hand-painted with our own secret-recipe sauce. Cornbread baked fresh every morning. And, of course, every meat smoked on-site over local hickory wood. It takes a lot to craft the city’s best barbeque, but you’ve got to start with great ingredients (and we do).

The nutritional values we’ve listed are based on our standard recipes and preparation methods, as well as information provided by our suppliers. Values for individual products may vary due to small differences in serving size, preparation methods, adjustments from our suppliers, and substitutions. Due to these factors, we can’t guarantee complete accuracy of our nutrition information.

Everything at City Barbeque is prepared on-site. Teammates in our joints handle ingredients including common allergens (sesame, wheat, peanuts, soy, tree nuts, milk, eggs, fish, and shellfish), and our smokers and kitchens use shared equipment with all our fresh ingredients. We will always indicate when a menu item contains a certain allergen, but we can’t guarantee any of our menu items are completely allergen-free.

Feel free to bookmark this page and check back, as our recipes do change slightly from time to time. Please also note not every menu item is served at every location: You may see menu items referenced here that aren’t on the menu at your local City Barbeque joint.

# Nutrition, Ingredients, Allergies & Sensitivities

It’s no secret that our customers crave the great taste of our super-premium, smooth and creamy ice cream. We take great pride in the fact that it’s made fresh, every day in every store, using only the finest quality ingredients. But sometimes customers want to know more, or in extreme cases, such as allergies or ingredient sensitivities, they need to know more. Find more information on our products, ingredients, allergies and sensitivities below.

## Allergens

Use our nutrition calculator to easily tailor your meal to your dietary preference. Click the drop-down allergen menu to filter ingredients by your needs & sensitivities.

  * Wheat Gluten – We are proud to offer many gluten-friendly options to our guests through entrée customization. While we have processes in place to reduce gluten coming in contact with your food, we cannot guarantee zero contamination due to the potential of flour in the air.
  * Nuts – Although our recipes do not contain any nuts, some of the ingredients we use may have been processed in facilities that package nuts and/or nut products.
  * Sodium – Our hot items are prepared with low sodium, making them a healthier choice for our guests.

# Nutrition & Allergen Guide

Culver’s Nutrition & Allergen Guide is a helpful tool for exploring nutrition, allergen, and ingredient information. To get the most out of this resource, use the Lifestyle Filter to select allergens you would like to avoid, then click into each category for more detail. 

For example, if you select 'avoid peanuts,’ you will need to open the Fresh Frozen Custard category to view menu items that do not contain peanuts.

citeturn145search4 [wordlim: 200] Crawled: today; View Nutrition & Allergen Guide ... ### [Button: Does your food contain corn syrup/HFCS?] ... ### [Button: Is Five Guys safe for people with tree nut allergies? ... Peanuts are served in all Five Guys restaurants, but none of our menu items contain tree nuts.

  *   * ## Your Guide To Our Ingredients

View Nutrition & Allergen Guide


### Frequently Asked Questions About Nutrition and Allergen

### [Button: Does your cheese have animal rennet/is it vegetarian friendly?]

We use Kraft American cheese. The product we use does not contain any meat-based enzymes or rennet.


### [Button: Does your food contain corn syrup/HFCS?]

The products we offer that contain high-fructose corn syrup are:

* Cattleman’s® brand BBQ sauce
* Heinz® brand ketchup
* Mount Olive® brand relish and pickle chips
* Our mayonnaise condiment
* The mushroom topping that we use
* Our fountain beverages.

Our buns also contain corn derivatives.

If this is an issue for you, please order your burger or dog without the bun.

### [Button: Is Five Guys safe for people with tree nut allergies? ]

Peanuts are served in all Five Guys restaurants, but none of our menu items contain tree nuts. They are also not used in our cooking process in any way.

However, please remember that there is always a risk of cross-contamination in our locations. 
### [Button: What are the ingredients in your buns?]

Our bread is a proprietary recipe. Our buns contain the following ingredients:
* Water
* Salt
* Sugar
* Vegetable Shortening (Contains Soy)
* Milk
* Eggs
* Bleached Bread Flour
* Yeast
* Sesame Seeds


### [Button: Do Five Guys French fries contain gluten?]

Five Guys fries contain no gluten. Our potatoes are freshly cut, soaked in water and ONLY fried in refined peanut oil using fryers that cook absolutely nothing else.

Please be aware that our bread does contain gluten, so there is always a risk for cross-contamination. If you have a gluten allergy, please tell your cashier when ordering and our team will take extra care to avoid cross-contamination by changing gloves more frequently.

Please review our Nutrition & Allergen PDF (opens in a new window) for the most accurate menu item information.

### [Button: Does Five Guys menu items contain MSG?]

There is no MSG added to our burgers, hot dogs, fries, seasonings or condiments. The only seasonings offered in our restaurants are salt and Cajun seasoning.

# FUZZy'S TaCo SHoP NutRitioN aND ALLeRGeN INfoRMatioN

Fuzzy’s Taco Shop is dedicated to delivering a delightful dining experience, offering transparency in our ingredients to empower guests to make informed choices. We proudly feature an array of delicious food options, crafted to satisfy every craving and bring smiles to the table.

### Fuzzy’s Taco Shop Food Allergy Listing

At Fuzzy’s Taco Shop, we provide allergen information for our guests with dietary restrictions and food allergies. Guests can review our allergen information and order knowing many delicious menu options exist at Fuzzy’s Taco Shop for everyone. As part of our commitment to you, we provide the most current allergen information available from our food suppliers on nine common allergenic foods.
These foods include: egg, fish, milk, peanuts, sesame, shellfish, soy, tree nuts, and wheat. In addition, we identify menu items with gluten-containing ingredients. Because we have multiple sources of allergens in our shared cooking and prep areas, including common fryer oil, we are unable to guarantee that any menu item can be completely free of allergens. In addition, we use highly refined soybean oil in our fryers, which the FDA exempts from being labeled an allergen. Due to the complexity of our ingredients, other allergenic foods may be present in a menu item, but not declared on this section or menu.

### Fuzzy’s Taco Shop Menu Nutrition Facts

Fuzzy’s Taco Shop is proud to present our guests with nutrition information to make every menu choice a success. Review our restaurant nutritional guide and find essential nutrition info on all our menu items. Enjoy every bite at Fuzzy’s Taco Shop!

### Fuzzy’s Taco Shop Vegan and Vegetarian Menu Guide

Find out how to eat vegan and vegetarian at Fuzzy’s Taco Shop.

# nutrition

## Nutritional & Allergen Info

### NUTRITIONAL INFORMATION

The ingredient information listed on our menus is meant to provide a general estimate of the nutritional values associated with our menu items.

### ALLERGEN INFORMATION

We understand the challenges facing the community of people who struggle with food allergies or have to manage food and beverage sensitivities in their lives. We know how difficult it is to eat safely, especially when eating out. It is important that you are aware that milk, eggs, tree nuts, seafood, soy, wheat, sesame products, crustacean shellfish, fish, sulfites and other allergens are present in our restaurants. We ask that when placing your order, you alert your server and the manager on duty to your food or beverage allergy or sensitivity. The more information relating to your specific needs you can provide, the better we can attempt to protect you. We will then try our best to avoid any accidental cross-contact, but we do not have separate equipment dedicated for the preparation of allergen based food requests.

citeturn150search0 [wordlim: 200] Crawled: today; The nature of our ingredients such as beans, meat and shredded cheese, means there is a risk of drips or shreds directly onto food preparation surfaces or meals being prepared. ... Where hot beverages are available, hot beverages served with any milk may contain milk, soy, almond and gluten.

## ALLERGENS AND FOOD SENSITIVITIES STATEMENT

Our menu and processes are evolving, and our restaurants are busier than ever. Whilst we take care to minimise contact between ingredients in our kitchens, our cooking and serving areas are open and we are quick-paced for fast service. 

We have introduced dividers between ingredients such as cheese, meat and non-meat ingredients, including eggs, to minimize transfer to neighbouring ingredients; however, this does not eliminate all risk. 

We handle flour tortillas, corn chips and cheese with gloved hands, meaning there can be transfer of these ingredients to meals being prepared. Whilst we use separate utensils for all other ingredients, sometimes they come into contact with the meal being prepared. The nature of our ingredients such as beans, meat and shredded cheese, means there is a risk of drips or shreds directly onto food preparation surfaces or meals being prepared. 

Therefore, our menu items may contain gluten, wheat, milk and egg. Removing an ingredient may not eliminate its presence. Any ingredient in our kitchen may be present in menu items 

Where hot beverages are available, hot beverages served with any milk may contain milk, soy, almond and gluten.

# Kona Grill Nutritional Information

## What's in your Kona Grill Meal?

At Kona Grill we serve more than modern american grill favorites or sushi. We are proud to offer over 60 lower calorie menu items. We can also cater your favorite dish to your needs, removing sauces, having the dressing on the side or deleting an item. Our servers and chefs are trained to accommodate your desires and can offer suggestions without sacrificing flavor. We want you to have the Kona Grill experience without compromising your dietary needs and goals.

## Made From Scratch

Not all ingredients are listed in the menu. Before placing your order, please contact the restaurant if a person in your party has a food allergy or other food sensitivities. Please be aware that kona grill is not a gluten-free environment. Our menu items are handcrafted in our kitchens, often times using shared equipment (including common fryers) and variations in vendor-supplied ingredients may occur.

Nutritional Information

Our top 6 Nutritional Information FAQs

### Nutritional Information

Nutritional Information

#### Can I enjoy Kona Grill and still eat mindfully

Yes — many of our menu options are suitable for balanced eating. Choosing lean proteins, swapping heavier sides, or asking for sauces on the side can help you keep things lighter.

#### Where can I find calorie counts for specific dishes

Our nutritional guides include exact calorie counts and key nutritional values for every menu item, including entrées, sushi, sides and drinks.

#### What if I’m looking for lower-calorie choices

Our nutrition guides make it easy to spot lower-calorie or lighter options. Grilled seafood, salads and plant-forward sides are great choices if you’re keeping calories down.

#### Can I use these guides to support a specific diet or goal

Yes. Whether you’re tracking macros, watching calories or managing sodium, our information helps you see how menu choices fit your preferences and goals.

#### How do I find allergen and dietary-sensitivity information

Allergen icons and notes appear on local menu pages. Because ingredients and preparations can vary, we recommend talking with your server if you have specific dietary needs or sensitivities.

## Nutritional info

To review the nutritional information for our products, please browse our menu for the latest information about each item.

Ingredient Information

The only animal by-products used in our doughnuts are eggs (whites and yolks) and dairy products (including milk, butter, yogurt, whey, nonfat milk and nonfat whey). To get further information about our products, call us at 1-800-4KRISPY.

Are Krispy Kreme Doughnuts Kosher?

All of our doughnuts are ingredient Kosher. Our mix plant in Winston-Salem, NC where the mix is made is certified Kosher. In addition, some of our stores, but not all, have been certified Kosher. Please contact your local shop for the most up-to date information.

Logan’s Roadhouse International, LLC does not endorse or make any specific representations, claims or advice about any particular eating lifestyle or diet. Any information provided by Logan’s Roadhouse is for general informational purposes only and is not intended to be a substitute for medical advice.

### NUTRITION MENU

The nutritional information contained in our restaurants or on our website (logansroadhouse.com) was prepared by Nutritional Information Services (NIS ). The information listed on our menus and websites is meant to provide a general estimate of the nutritional values associated with our menu items. The estimated nutritional values for a menu item may vary from the testing results due to variations in: serving sizes; preparation techniques; ingredient recipes supplied by our vendors; both seasonal and regional differences in products supplied to us; supplier substitutions; and, supplier testing methods. Nutritional values for some menu items, such as those that are limited time only or are regional in nature, are not available at this time.

### ALLERGEN MENU

Our menu items are largely made from scratch in a common kitchen using shared equipment. Many of our products contain or may come into contact with the nine major food allergens, including wheat, peanuts, soy, tree nuts, milk, eggs, fish, crustacean shellfish and sesame. Our products may also contain or come into contact with other food allergens due to cross-contact that is inherent in a common kitchen or due to allergens that are not disclosed in the ingredients our kitchens use. Our managers are trained to identify known ingredients in our menu items and to describe preparation and cooking methods, but our kitchens are not able to guarantee that a menu item is allergen-free or gluten-free due to the inherent risks we have just described. Customers with food allergies should exercise judgment in light of these inherent risks.

Logan’s Roadhouse International, LLC does not endorse or make any specific representations, claims or advice about any particular eating lifestyle or diet. Any information provided by Logan’s Roadhouse is for general informational purposes only and is not intended to be a substitute for medical advice. Consult with your physician, registered dietitian, or other health professional if you have questions or concerns about your health, diet and/or specific nutritional needs.

citeturn172search7 [wordlim: 200] Published: 12.6 years ago; Crawled: yesterday; After reviewing a large number of nutritional information pages on restaurant websites, we concluded that a “nutrition calculator’ would be an excellent approach for us to follow. ... Monical’s Pizza is working to provide enjoyable food of high quality with the information our guests need to make good meal decisions.

You can find the nutritional calculator under the menu section. Some locations have the calculator while others have a pdf of the nutritional information. If you have any additional questions, please let us know.
Thank you.

#### Dharmen Parikshak

June 8, 2014 at 11:30 am

We wanted to know if any of the menu items (and which ones) contain eggs and/or peanuts/nuts or peanut oil. We are planning to have family get together and have few people with allergy issues. Thanks in advance for your reply.

     * Image

#### Monical's Pizza

June 11, 2014 at 8:30 am

You may find the information you are looking for under the menu section for each location. The information will be in either the nutrition calculator or the PDF of nutritional info for that location. Thank you!

#### Donna mcgee

May 28, 2015 at 1:33 pm

Calories in in 8 inch Italian sausage pizza

     * Image

#### Monical's Pizza

May 28, 2015 at 1:46 pm

Our 8″ Thin crust sausage pizza has 605 calories!

#### Ben mason

August 14, 2015 at 7:43 pm

One serving is one pizza 200 carbs. This is very difficult to calculate for my diabetic son. Especially because your pizzas are normally cut into uneven squares not somewhat symmetrical 8 slices. Maybe you guys could simplify it down to carbs per ounce?

     * Image

#### Monical's Pizza

August 24, 2015 at 11:23 am

We will pass that suggestion along. Typically, a 14″ pizza would serve 2-3 people, and a 16″ pizza would serve 3-4, so the carbs would be divided accordingly!

# Nutrition

Mountain Mike’s serves a range of high-quality foods that can fit into any well-balanced diet. The documents below will provide you with nutritional information on our products to help you make informed choices.

Our goal is to provide you with the information you need to make sensible decisions about balance, variety and healthfulness of your diet.

Nutrition & Allergen Information*

Pizza Calorie Chart*

Mountain Mike’s attempts to provide nutrition and ingredient information regarding its products that is as complete as possible. Some menu items may not be available at all restaurants. While the ingredient information is based on standard product formulations, variations may occur depending on location, region of the country and the season of the year.

Further, product formulations change periodically. Serving sizes may vary from quantity upon which the analysis was conducted. All products may contain trace amounts of ingredients derived from animals. If you wish further information or have special sensitivities or dietary concerns regarding specific ingredients in specific menu items please contact us for additional nutritional details.

* Our product allergens are listed for the ingredients used. We cannot guarantee that ingredients are manufactured in buildings that contain no other allergens.

## Store Information

How do I find my neighborhood store?

You can locate a store near you by using our helpful Store Locator.

What time do you open?

We bake our bagels fresh every morning, which means we’re up pretty early! Each store is different, so find your bakery’s hours by using our Store Locator.

Are you open on holidays?

Noah’s Bagels locations are closed on Christmas Day to allow our team members to spend time with their family and friends. Some Noah’s locations may be closed on additional holidays based on local store management discretion. We encourage our guests to check the store hours for their neighborhood bakery prior to visiting on holidays.

When will my bakery re-open their dining room?

While the majority of our bakeries have re-opened their dining rooms, we have decided to transition some smaller bakeries or bakeries in select locations to takeout only bakeries. You can find the status of this and other amenities for your neighborhood bakery on our locations page.

How do I request a refund?

We’re sorry your last experience with us missed the mark. To request a refund, Contact Us and complete the form. For fastest resolution, please include the order total, order date, name on the credit card used, last 4 digits of the credit card used and the expiration date along with the reason why you are requesting a refund. Our team will follow up to your request via email.

Does Noah's Bagels donate or participate in charity events & fundraisers?

All donation and charity requests are handled by your local bakery GM. Please call or visit your local bakery to determine if your donation or charity event may be a good fit.
Looking for your local bakery? Search locations.

## Nutritional Info

Where can I find nutrition, ingredient, & allergen information for Noah's Bagels menu items?

Absolutely! You can find nutrition & allergy information for both in-store & catering menus here.

If I have food allergies or other special needs, will I still be able to dine at Noah's Bagels?

Please know that we are always happy to accommodate any dietary need or food allergy the best we can; however, there is always a risk of cross-contamination in our stores.
Need more details? View full nutritional and allergen information.

Do you have any gluten free or keto-friendly bagels?

At this time, we do not have any plans to carry gluten free or keto-friendly bagels as a regular product in our stores. However, we are always working hard to find ways to improve and expand our offerings so this may change in the future. In the meantime, please check back with us for any updates as we are continuously rolling out new and exciting menu items!
View our menu to see all we have to offer today!

## Order Ahead

When can I place an Order Ahead order either online or in the app?

Guests can place online or in-app orders up to 3 days in advance and up until 15 minutes prior to the desired pick-up time. The last available time slot for order ahead pickup is 30 minutes prior to closing. Please note catering orders can be placed several weeks in advance through our dedicated catering ordering site.

Check your bakery’s operating hours on our locations page.

## Learn More About Allergens

Many of our products contain or may come into contact with common allergens, including wheat, peanuts, soy, tree nuts, milk, eggs, fish, shellfish and sesame.

 

Our bakery-cafe and catering menus vary by location due to, among other things, market tests and local requirements. If you have an allergy concern, please ask a manager at your bakery-cafe to check the ingredient listing for specific menu items. Please note that we cannot guarantee that any of our menu items are free of allergens because we use shared equipment and handle common allergens throughout our supply chain and bakery-cafe. To learn more about nutrition for our Panera At Home™ consumer packaged products, please see the detailed ingredient listing on the applicable packaging or the Panera At Home pages on PaneraBread.com.

### About Our Nutrition Information

Nutritional information provided on this Site about our standard bakery-cafe and catering menu items is based on Panera's standardized recipes, representative values provided by suppliers, analysis using industry standard software, published resources, and/or testing conducted in accredited laboratories, and are expressed in values based on federal rounding and other applicable regulations. A number of factors may affect the actual nutrition values for each product and, as such, Panera cannot guarantee the complete accuracy of the nutritional information provided on this Site, on PaneraBread.com or in our bakery-cafes.

 

For our US bakery-cafes, nutrition information for our standard bakery-cafe and most catering menu items can be found on our United States Nutrition Information Guide PDF on panerabread.com and our US catering page. Check back often for updates. Nutrition information about our Panera At Home™ consumer packaged products is available on the product packaging and on the Panera At Home™ pages on PaneraBread.com.

 

Panera does not endorse or make any specific representations, claims or advice about any particular eating lifestyle or diet. # NUTRITION

## Nutrition & Allergens

Where do I find the full list of ingredients?

Papa Murphy’s detailed ingredient information is on the Reference to the nutrition facts on the Nutrition PageNutrition page. Click on a specific product to display nutrition facts and ingredients.

How long can I keep unbaked pizza in the refrigerator?

Always bake pizzas within 24 hours of purchase. Remove refrigerated pizza 60 minutes prior to baking for crust to rise.

Does Papa Murphy's have gluten-free, dairy-free, or keto-friendly pizza options?

Our lifestyle-friendly options include: Udi's certified gluten-free crust, Violife dairy-free cheese, and crustless keto-friendly pizzas – all available Select a store to begin your online orderonline and in-store at Papa Murphy's locations.

 

Gluten-free crust (available in medium size only) is topped in a shared kitchen that also handles gluten-containing ingredients; dairy-free cheese options are prepared in the same shared kitchen areas as options containing dairy. Detailed ingredient information is on the Reference to the nutrition facts at the top of the Nutrition PageNutrition page. Click on a specific product to display nutrition facts and ingredients.. We do not assume responsibility for any sensitivity or allergy caused by our products.

Does Papa Murphy's have vegetarian and vegan pizza options?

Yes, we have many vegetarian and vegan options: Our original, thin, pan, and stuffed pizza crusts are vegan. Udi's gluten-free crust, however, contains eggs. We also have plant-based and lactose-free Violife dairy-free cheese and a wide selection of vegan toppings. Detailed ingredient information is on the Reference to the nutrition facts at the top of the Nutrition PageNutrition page. Click on a specific product to display nutrition facts and ingredients.

Cheese, please! Does your cheese contain animal rennet?

The enzymes or rennet used in our cheese production is from a non-animal source. 

I have a nutty allergy. Do your products contain peanuts or tree nuts?

Potential cross-contamination of both peanuts and tree nuts from our vendors may exist from shared production equipment and facilities. We are unable to make any guarantees of peanut- and tree nut-free products and continue to work with our vendors to obtain the most current and accurate information.

Can I eat any of your products – like your Cookie Dough – raw?

Our Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough is now Ready-to-Eat and can be enjoyed baked or raw, although we recommend our guests bake our cookies to truly have the Take ‘n’ Bake experience!

What are your pizza sizes and how many slices do you get?

It’s all in how you slice it, but here's our guidance for nutrition information. 

Medium = 12" = 8 slices 

Family = 16" = 12 slices 

XLNY = 16" = 12 slices 

Large = 14” = 8 slices  

Crustless = 8 servings per tray 

Are there genetically modified organisms in any of your products?

We currently do not collect information regarding GMOs from our vendors. As we work to make further enhancements to the products we offer, please stay tuned for updates. 

If you have further questions about specific ingredients, please contact the Papa Murphy’s Quality Assurance Department at papamurphysqa@papamurphys.co

No allergen or nutritional information in restaurant materials or our website should ever be considered a guarantee, but simply our effort to better serve our customers.

## Nutrition & Allergy Info

Rock Bottom Allergen Chart

### Nutritional Information

The nutritional information contained in our restaurants or on our website (www.rockbottom.com) was prepared by Nutritional Information Services (NIS ). The information listed on our menus and websites is meant to provide a general estimate of the nutritional values associated with our menu items. The estimated nutritional values for a menu item may vary from the testing results due to variations in: serving sizes; preparation techniques; ingredient recipes supplied by our vendors; both seasonal and regional differences in products supplied to us; supplier substitutions; and, supplier testing methods. Nutritional values for some menu items, such as those that are limited time only or are regional in nature, are not available at this time.

### Allergen Information

We understand the challenges facing the community of people who struggle with food allergies or have to manage food and beverage sensitivities in their lives. We know how difficult it is to eat safely, especially when eating out. Your options are severely limited because of the absence of available information. It is important that you are aware that milk, eggs, tree nuts, seafood, soy, wheat, sesame products, crustacean shellfish, fish, sulfites and other allergens are present in our restaurants. We ask that when placing your order you alert your server and the manager on duty to your food or beverage allergy or sensitivity. The more information relating to your specific needs you can provide, the better we can attempt to protect you. We will then try our best to avoid any accidental cross-contact, but we do not have separate equipment dedicated for the preparation of allergen based food requests . All food in our establishment may come into contact with surfaces, fryers, grills, utensils or other equipment that have previously contacted an allergen . Finally, it is a good idea to remind your server about your request when your food arrives at the table in order to confirm that you are receiving the correct dish.

### Supplier Disclosures

The nutritional and allergen information provided here and on our websites is based entirely on the information provided by our ingredient manufacturers and suppliers. We have limited this disclosure to the "Big 8" (wheat, soy, milk, eggs, peanuts, tree nuts, fish and shellfish) as those are the only ones manufacturers are required to disclose. Suppliers may change the ingredients in their products or the way they prepare their products without informing us. From time to time we or our suppliers may substitute products due to inventory shortages and we can't be sure that the substitute products will be free of the allergen you wish to avoid. If there are changes we are made aware of we will update our website, so please check our website frequently.

## Nutrition Analysis

Shoney's® engaged an independent third party consultant, MenuTrinfo, LLC, to provide nutrition analysis of Shoney's restaurants' standard menu and buffet items, using the ingredients identified in Shoney's current recipes, to use in Shoney's menu and buffet labeling.

The nutrition information prepared by MenuTrinfo, LLC is based on standard serving sizes and current recipes prepared with specified ingredients. The nutrition data is based on representative values from the USDA Nutrient Database for Standard Reference and information from ingredient and product suppliers.

NUTRITION VALUES ARE REASONABLE ESTIMATES ONLY. SHONEY'S DISCLAIMS ANY AND ALL WARRANTIES AND REPRESENTATIONS REGARDING THE ACCURACY OR RELIABILITY OF NUTRITION VALUES IN THE NUTRITION INFORMATION.

The actual nutrition values of menu and buffet items may vary significantly from the nutrition information provided due to the handcrafted nature of those items and/or due to seasonal influences on the ingredients. Additionally, we may change our recipes and preparation methods, substitute ingredients and change suppliers, as may be necessary from time to time, which may alter the nutrition values and may not be reflected in the nutritional information.

Shoney's franchisees may prepare and offer local menu and buffet items which use recipes and ingredients that have different nutrition values than those MenuTrinfo, LLC used in preparing nutrition information. The nutrition information prepared by MenuTrinfo and on this website is not intended for use with those items. Those franchisees may provide nutrition data for those local items they may serve.

Allergen information has been provided by MenuTrinfo to help give our guests the tools to make an informed food decision, based on information obtained from ingredient and product suppliers.

Additionally, we may change our recipes and preparation methods, substitute ingredients and change suppliers, as may be necessary from time to time, which may alter the allergen information and may not be reflected in the allergen chart.

Whey, plant-based, and collagen. Choose what best fits your goals.

Apple juice, pineapple juice, and coconut water. Never high-fructose corn syrup.

### Natural Sweeteners

Honey, dates, stevia. 0g added sugar in many of our smoothies.

Nonfat milk with no rBST/rBGH added hormones.

### Allergen Free

Every smoothie is gluten free, plus find plenty of nut and dairy free options on the menu.

Each menu item lists nutrition based on a standard recipe and 20oz size. Add-ins and size choices update the totals dynamically in our calculator.

evidence.text:
citeturn208search0 [wordlim: 200] Published: 7 months ago; Crawled: today; The nutrition information, allergens, and dietary needs are based on Taco John’s International, Inc.’s current standard product formulations, information from product suppliers, independent laboratories, and the USDA Agricultural Research Service Nutrient Data Laboratory, as of the date of publication. ... Menu items served in Taco John’s® restaurants that are cobranded with Steak Escape or Good Times Burgers & Custard may come in contact with allergens or ingredients from the other brand, such as peanut oil in the fryers of Steak Escape restaurants and peanuts used in treat preparation in Good Times restaurants.

# Nutrition & Allergen Information

Download Nutritional Information (PDF)

Download Allergen Information (PDF)

The nutrition information, allergens, and dietary needs are based on Taco John’s International, Inc.’s current standard product formulations, information from product suppliers, independent laboratories, and the USDA Agricultural Research Service Nutrient Data Laboratory, as of the date of publication. The rounding of figures is based on FDA guidelines. Allergens and ingredients for limited-time offers, test items, and regional items may not be included.

Content and allergens are subject to change. Due to shared equipment and preparation areas, we cannot eliminate the risk of cross-contact or guarantee any item is free of any allergen. Menu items served in Taco John’s® restaurants that are cobranded with Steak Escape or Good Times Burgers & Custard may come in contact with allergens or ingredients from the other brand, such as peanut oil in the fryers of Steak Escape restaurants and peanuts used in treat preparation in Good Times restaurants. 
No items are certified “gluten-free” or “dairy-free.” Taco John’s items that are made without gluten-containing ingredients or dairy-containing ingredients are prepared in common kitchen areas, including common fryer oil, as gluten and dairy products.

The FDA does not require foods that contain refined soybean oil to be listed as a soy allergen. Our soybean oil is highly refined oil, unless otherwise specified. Highly refined soybean oil does not contain soy protein and therefore does not demonstrate hazardous risk to those allergic individuals. Although soy lecithin is a refined oil, research has shown it may contain trace amounts of soy protein. For this reason, items that contain soy lecithin are marked as containing “soy”.

Slight variations to nutrition information may occur due to natural variability within ingredients and regional availability of products. Menu offerings may vary by location. Test products, test recipes, limited-time menu items, and regional offerings may not be included. The information is updated periodically; we suggest you check back each time you dine with us.

For specific ingredient information, please contact us via our website.

Toppers Pizza is committed to serving bold, flavorful food made with quality ingredients, and we’re proud to provide the most up-to-date nutrition and allergen information straight from our suppliers.

## Allergen Notice

Tropical Smoothie Cafe® serves freshly made food and smoothies that may contain or come in contact with allergens, including eggs, fish, milk, peanuts, sesame, shellfish, soy, tree nuts, and wheat.

Important notice

Please be aware that we cannot guarantee that any menu item is gluten-free, vegetarian, or free from allergens, including eggs, fish, milk, peanuts, sesame, shellfish, soy, tree nuts or wheat. Our normal cafe operations involve shared cooking and preparation areas, equipment and utensils. In addition, ingredients or production methods used by our suppliers may change, there may be product differences among regional suppliers, or we may need to substitute ingredients in menu items. Please refer to the nutrition guide to choose menu items that are right for you and meet your dietary needs. Consult with a healthcare professional or your physician about any food allergies, food intolerances or sensitivities, or dietary restrictions.

Need more detailed nutrition information?

Nutrition Guide (PDF)

Dietary notes

Vegetarian options

Tropical Smoothie Cafe® offers vegetarian menu items, which do not include animal meats, but may include eggs, dairy, fish, honey and foods with animal by-products. In addition, many of our menu items can be made using a plant-based chicken substitute.

Image: Gluten-Friendly

Gluten-Friendly options

Tropical Smoothie Cafe® offers “gluten-friendly” menu items, which are made using gluten-free ingredients.

evidence.title: Walker Bros Frequently Asked Questions
evidence.text:
citeturn213search0 [wordlim: 200] Crawled: 2.5 years ago; Do you have any nutritional information about Walker Bros. food served?
Download Printable Menu Here

Are there any Walker Bros. locations outside the Northern Suburbs of Chicago?

Walker Bros is part of The Original Pancake House franchise. Walker Bros. is only located in the Northern suburbs of Chicago, however The Original Pancake House has locations throughout the U.S.http://www.originalpancakehouse.com

Can I purchase gift cards for Walker Bros.? If so, in what demonations do they come?

Gift Cards are available at all locations in any denomination from $10 to $250 . Check out our Gift Card information page for more info. Gift Cards are also available for online purchase through this link.

I have allergies, Do you have a allergy information sheet?

Here is a printable copy of our allergy information sheet. Our management would be happy to discuss any concerns you may have and the ingredients used in the preparation of our recipes. 
Peanut oil is used in preparation of the following menu items:  Buttermilk, Blueberry, Banana, Pecan, Bacon, Swedish, 49er's Flapjacks, Chocolate Chippies, Little Dollars, Wheat Germ, Buckwheat, Three Little Pigs in a Blanket, The Grand Treat and a side of pancakes.  Kids Menu items: $5 Chocolate chip, $5 Blueberry, Junior Plate and 3 Buttermilk Pancakes

What credit cards do you accept?

We accept Visa, MasterCard, Discover and American Express

Do you have any nutritional information about Walker Bros. food served?

We do have nutritional facts on the frozen apple pancake, but unfortunately for the rest of the menu we do not have that information available to us at this time.

How do I prepare the Frozen Apple Pancake?

Pre-heat your oven to 375 degrees. Remove plastic and lid but leave in baking tin. Bake Apple Pancake in the tin for 50 to 60 minutes on middle rack until pancake rises and turns golden brown. We recommend letting the pancake cool for 5 minutes before serving. Baking times may vary. For best results do not microwave. 

Where can I buy a Frozen Apple Pancake?

Our Frozen Apple Pancakes are available at each of our Walker Bros. locations as well as at local Sunset Foods Grocery Stores

## Willy’s Favorites

You don’t just serve fresh grilled Mexican food for over three decades without stumbling upon a masterpiece or two. Enjoy a few of our specialties, each complete with a side of FREE chips and salsa.

###### Willy Philly Burrito

Steak, rice, cheese dip, cheddar cheese, peppers & onions, and serrano crema.

###### Baja Burrito

Chicken or steak, Monterey Jack cheese, sautéed peppers & onions. Grilled and smothered in enchilada sauce and cheese dip.

###### Willy's Frito Burrito

Adobe chicken served with Frito chips, rice, pinto beans, sour cream, chipotle puree and Willy’s cheese dip.

###### Goal Bowl

Lettuce, adobe chicken, pico de gallo, guacamole, and cucumbers.

###### Taco Salad

A fried crispy tortilla shell loaded with ground beef, black beans, lettuce, cheese dip, pico de gallo, sour cream, and guacamole.

###### Southwest Chicken Salad

Grilled chicken, black beans, pico de gallo, corn salsa, jack cheese, guacamole, and tortilla strips.

## Build Your Own

Make your favorite Willy’s item the way you like it. Every order comes with a side of FREE chips and salsa.

###### Build Your Own Burrito

Vegetarian rice, your choice of beans, and endless combinations of fresh ingredients tightly wrapped in a soft tortilla.

###### Build Your Own Bowl

All the delicious rice, beans, proteins, and veggies you love in a burrito minus the tortilla or served on the side.

###### Build Your Own Salad

Crisp greens with your choice of protein, fresh ingredients, and house-made dressings – Chipotle Ranch, Lite Tomatillo Ranch and SW Vinaigrette.

###### Build Your Own Quesadilla

Soft flour tortilla stuffed with your favorite protein and grilled to crispy perfection and served with pico de gallo salsa and sour cream. Make it a Grande Quesadilla – larger tortilla with more ingredients and guacamole included.

###### Build Your Own Tacos

Two tacos served in your choice of soft flour, soft corn, or crispy corn tortillas. Topped with your favorite freshly made ingredients.

###### Nachos

Homemade tortilla chips topped with whatever you want. Served with beans, salsa, sour cream, and guacamole.

## Family Meals

Take It Home. Build Your Own.

Our Build-Your-Own Taco Box is the perfect solutions for families on the go, small gatherings, work meetings, or when there is just no time to cook.

Feeds 4-6 people and includes the following:

Choice of two proteins, lettuce, Monterey Jack cheese, pico de gallo, sour cream, choice of one salsa and 16 hard/soft shells.

Side items: Rice, choice of black/pinto beans and chips
